The man takes a bite of a chicken wing and expresses delight through wide eyes and a smile. (6) The man and woman are seen toasting with clear glasses in a retro-style bar with posters on the wall. They appear high-energy, laughing and looking directly into the lens. The video ends with a rapid cut to the man smiling widely.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a high-energy promotional campaign for a collaboration between Doritos and various bars in Taiwan titled 'Bar Quest'. It aims to encourage social drinking and dining by showcasing unique Doritos-themed snacks and cocktail pairings across different popular nightlife spots, targeting a young adult 'office worker' demographic.
